assumptions.formula: Q_next = Q_last * (Q_last / Q_previous)^g; L_next = Q_next * retention; log B is linear between dated anchors

coefficientEstimation.growthRetention: Zero-intercept least squares of next completed log peak growth on previous log peak growth
coefficientEstimation.periodDays: Median confirmed peak-to-peak episode duration, rounded to whole days
coefficientEstimation.bearDays: Median confirmed peak-to-trough duration, rounded to whole days
coefficientEstimation.zoneLeadDays: Median first 95% high-zone entry to confirmed peak duration, rounded to whole days

simulation.bandMeaning: Conditional Monte Carlo 10th–90th percentiles, not validated 80% coverage or a simultaneous path band
simulation.centerMeaning: Pointwise median; generally not an individually realizable trajectory
simulation.sharedBlockLaw: Circular standardized return blocks; wraparound boundary assumed

assumptions.stateClock: Confirmation knownAt; return at t uses state known at t−1
assumptions.driftFormula: mu_s = n_s/(n_s+365)*mean(r_s); future drift decays with 180-day half-life

simulation.bandMeaning: Conditional Monte Carlo 10th–90th percentiles, not validated 80% coverage or a simultaneous path band

simulation.parametersEstimatedFrom: All continuous post-Merge observations through the current origin only

assumptions.innovationSource: All post-Merge returns in the continuous origin prefix, including observations with no confirmed threshold state
assumptions.driftFormula: Explicit future log drift = 0; historical mean is used only to center fitted shocks
assumptions.comparisonScope: State conditioning and drift policy both differ from adaptiveEth; not a one-component causal ablation

reasons: Current-vintage retrospective price replay is not prospective performance
Economic point-in-time network inputs are not manufactured

scope: Historical dates restrict all predictor prefixes and matured error fitting. Prices are the current stored archive, not recovered historical publication vintages. 30/90/180-day errors do not validate 2030–2035 paths. Interval results are retrospective experiments, not forecast probabilities.
